This record promotes nothing. docs/validation/claim-register.yaml and REFERENCE_SLOTS in src/validation/crossCheck.ts are untouched.

What this study compares is the georeferencing of a DTM raster: grid origin, cell indexing and row order. It does NOT compare aggregation over a realistic cloud, and the reason is in the parameter set: PDAL's writers.gdal is a radius estimator and rasterizeDtm is a cell estimator, a disc is not a square, and on scattered returns over sloping ground the two cannot agree exactly however the parameters are set. One return per cell centre with a radius below half a cell removes that confound; the cost is that the input is a degenerate cloud, and the cost is stated rather than absorbed into a wider tolerance.

datasets.description: Bare earth on a 5.4 % plane, one return per 1 m cell at the cell centre, 50 by 50 cells. The plane falls in both x and y, so a transposed or mirrored grid moves cells by up to a metre.
The same layout over a rolling surface with two incommensurate wavelengths, so no translation of the grid maps the surface onto itself and a one-cell shift cannot cancel.
The same layout over a 30 % V ridge, where a half-cell offset costs 15 cm and is well clear of the tolerance.

parameterSets.description: Lowest return per cell, 1 m cells, grid pinned to origin (0, 0) and 50 by 50 cells on both sides. The reference radius of 0.45 m is below half a cell, so each cell's disc holds exactly the one return that belongs to that cell and the radius estimator and the cell estimator compute the same quantity.

Aggregation over a realistic cloud. The input is one return per cell at the cell centre, chosen so the two estimators coincide; a scattered cloud would compare a disc against a square and is out of scope here.
Empty cells. Every cell in every fixture receives exactly one return, so nothing here says anything about how either side marks or fills a cell with no data.
One aggregation and one cell size. Nothing here says anything about mean, median, percentile or robust aggregation, or about any cell size other than 1 m.
Agreement with PDAL is not accuracy against ground truth.
